context_requirements: ER-positive breast cancer cells (MCF7) for the strongest ESR1-mediated transcriptional response
Expression of estrogen receptor alpha (ESR1) or estrogen receptor beta (ESR2)
For non-hormonal contraceptives (gossypol, lonidamine analogs), Bcl-2/Bcl-XL overexpression or mitochondrial dependence may be required for apoptosis
falsifiers: No change in canonical estrogen-responsive genes (e.g., TFF1, PGR, GREB1) in MCF7 cells at 6 or 24 hours
No antiproliferative or apoptotic response in any of the nine cell lines
Strong upregulation of proliferation markers (e.g., CCNA2, CCNB1, MKI67) at 24 hours
Lack of any transcriptional response across all cell lines and time points

evidence.supports: Lonidamine-derived male contraceptive BHD induces apoptosis of spermatogenic cells and disrupts blood-testis barrier, suggesting apoptotic and cell-junction effects.
Gossypol-acetic acid, a male contraceptive, inhibits gastric cancer cell proliferation and affects cell cycle and apoptosis pathways.
(-)-Gossypol directly acts on mitochondria and overcomes Bcl-2/Bcl-XL-mediated apoptosis resistance, inducing cell death.
2-Methoxyestradiol, an estrogen metabolite/contraceptive-related agent, induces apoptosis in endothelial cells via stress-activated protein kinase and Fas.

changes: Removed CDKN1A from proximal_down because it is listed in late_up and cannot appear in both an up and a down list of the same time; its induction is consistent with stress/apoptosis at 24 h.
Removed generic proliferation/stress genes (CCND1, MYC, GADD45B, IER3) from proximal_up to avoid non-specific immediate-early and proliferation effects.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes (CDKN1A, TGFB3, IGFBP3, SERPINE1, MMP1, MMP2, COL1A1, COL4A1, CXCR4) from proximal_down because they are not specific proximal transcriptional targets of a contraceptive agent.
Removed generic proliferation/stress genes (CDKN1A, GADD45A, BAX, PMAIP1, TNFRSF21, SQSTM1, TRIB3, DDIT4, ATF5) from late_up to avoid non-specific stress/apoptosis signatures.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes (CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, CDC20, BUB1B, AURKA, AURKB, TOP2A, PLK1, UBE2C, KIF20A, NUSAP1, MELK) from late_down because they are generic proliferation markers rather than specific contraceptive-agent targets.
Kept line_response as provided; no known lineage, driver mutation, receptor expression, TP53/RB status, or immortalisation data contradict the assigned levels.
Kept kinetics and magnitude as provided; slow kinetics and weak-to-moderate magnitude are compatible with the mechanism.
Kept all evidence citations because each abstract supports the stated claim.
